title: Modified Frame-projected Independent Fiber Photometry System Hardware
author: Kenta M. Hagihara

steps.title: Prepare Collimator Assemblies
steps.instruction: Create two assemblies by attaching collimator F220SMA-532 to kinematic collimator mount KAD11F (ensuring no protrusion of the collimator), then attaching them to SM1L05.

steps.title: Prepare DFM1 Cubes
steps.instruction: Prepare the DFM1 cubes with mirrors and filters.

substeps.instruction: Attach RS1P to each DFM1.
Secure emission filters FF01-520/35 and FF01-630/69 to the insert of the top left green/red emission cube DFM1 using O-rings, matching the filter arrows to the light path direction.
Attach four dichroic mirrors to DFM1s according to Fig 2. Place Semrock mirrors label-down and Edmund Optics mirrors coating face-up (arrow pointing to coated surface).

Remove the insert from the bottom left (470/415 excitation) cube and secure excitation filters FBH410-10 and FBH470-10 using O-rings, matching the arrows to the light propagation direction (O-ring grooves facing up).

steps.title: Assemble 560nm Collimator
steps.instruction: Attach collimator F950SMA-A to AD15F, ensuring the backside of both are level to avoid damaging the filter. Place FB560-10 inside SM1L05 (observing direction), attach the collimator to SM1L05, and then attach this to the 560 DFM1 (bottom right cube).

steps.title: Connect DFM1 Cubes
steps.instruction: Join the four DFM1 cubes into a 2x2 arrangement.

substeps.instruction: Attach two ER025 orthogonally to each DFM1, removing the second screw from each ER025 so only one screw remains per cube face.
Use CP33 to join the DFM1s at the ER025 locations, using three CP33s in total to connect four cubes.
Maintain orientation based on the Thorlabs logo and Fig 1/2.
Tighten all CP33 screws.
Close unused DFM1 holes with SM1CP2 to minimize stray light.

steps.title: Assemble Main Body Components
steps.instruction: Attach the remaining hardware to the main body.

substeps.instruction: Assemble SM1P1, CP33, SM1L05, and AC-254-080 in that order.
Attach 2x ER2-P4 to the top left DFM1 (green/red emission collection cube).
Attach SM1AB2 and SM1A9 to CMOS cameras, then slide them into the main body using ER2.
Remove two rings from SM05T2 and screw it into fiber mount CXYZ05. Assemble the fiber bundle with SM05SMA (or SM05FC for patchcables), SM05L03, and CXYZ05, then attach to the main body.
Attach the objective lens to the main body using adapter SM1A12 and ER4.

steps.title: Setup Breadboard and Electronics
steps.instruction: Place the assembled main body on a breadboard and integrate electronics.

substeps.instruction: Place LEDs (M415F3, M470F3, M565F3) and LED controllers (LEDD1B) on the breadboard.
Connect CMOS cameras to the data acquisition PC via USB cables.
Connect LEDs to the main body collimators using M59L01 patch fibers.
Set LED driver 'CURRENT LIMIT' settings: M565F3 to 700mA, M415F3 to 1500mA, and M470F4 to 1000mA.
Connect CMOS cameras and LED drivers to the TTL generating device using BNC and Hirose cables.
Attach the two assemblies created in the first step to the 415/470 DFM1 (bottom left cube).
Remove all remaining O-rings from DFM1 and CP33.
Remove the 493_574 cube insert (top right) and unscrew the SM1CP2 cap.
Place a white non-reflective surface in front of the hole.
Turn on the 565nm LED to project light onto the surface.
Turn on 415nm and 470nm LEDs one by one and adjust collimators to match the 565nm LED propagation angle.

steps.title: Align Fiber Bundle
steps.instruction: Center the fiber bundle on the excitation path.

substeps.instruction: Insert the 493_574 cube and turn the 470nm LED to highest power to create a 'hotspot' on the white surface.
Use the X and Y knobs on the CXYZ05 to center the fiber bundle shadow on the hotspot.
Repeat this centering process for each LED.
Set camera settings using Spinview and adjust the Z knob on the CXYZ05 to bring the fiber bundle into focus.
Set LED drivers to Trigger mode and test the TTL generating device triggering.
